summary: The chat picker now carries endpoint capabilities and excludes models that do not support chat completions, without altering System One discovery.

evidence: static/chat.js:207-209 merges supported_endpoints from capability records into picker model entries.
static/chat.js:365-368 filters out entries whose supported_endpoints omit /v1/chat/completions, excluding the System One model that only advertises /v1/systemone.
The change is confined to the chat picker; discovery endpoints remain unchanged.
